title: Not excluding `accruedProtocolFee` from state update operations causes several issues
summary: _Resolved_  ## Severity  **Impact:** Medium  **Likelihood:** High  ## Description  Covenant governance can turn on protocol fees, which if done, can cause several issues.  When `_calculateMarketState` is called, it calculates the accrued fee based on `baseTokenSupply`. This fee is added to `protocolFeeGrowth` and deducted from `baseTokenSupply`.
